notes.title: Announcement of the cessation of operations
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Announcement of the cessation of operations for "Figure Adventure"

Dear collectors:

It is with great regret that we inform you that due to adjustments in our operational strategy, "Figure Adventure" will soon terminate its services in your region. Thank you all for your long-term love and companionship！



From now until the cessation of operational services, collectors can continue to play the game as usual. Today, the final thank-you gift will be distributed in-game: \[100 x Super Blind Box Coupon, 60 x Limited Blind Box Card], which can be claimed via \[Email].



To ensure the orderly progression of the process, we will gradually shut down relevant services according to the following time nodes：



Time schedule：

1. September 19th: Game registration and recharge functions will be closed.

2. September 25th: The game will stop selling on Steam\\Google Play \\ iOS

3. October 15th: Shut down the server and stop logging into the game



Instructions：

If you have any questions, please send an email to our dedicated customer service channel: [/p][p][url="https://liming9964@outlook.com"]liming9964@outlook.com[/url][/p][p]. Our customer service staff will communicate with you via email regarding relevant matters
(Including but not limited to issues related to data retention, recharge payments, etc.)
We are deeply reluctant to bid farewell this time. We once again extend our sincerest apologies for any inconvenience caused to you. Thank you for your support and love for "Figure Adventure" along the way. The time we have spent with all the collectors will become our precious memories.[/p]

notes.title: Major Updates
notes.content:
I. "Sunflower Girl" Series Limited-Time Event
※Event Schedule: Aug. 16, 06:00 - Aug. 22, 23:59
1. "Sunflower Girl" Dice for Prizes
※Event info: "Sunflower Girl" Limited-Time Event is now available! Masters can use "Energy Dice" and "Miracle Dice" to advance according to the number of points rolled and trigger events on the different grids she lands on. When the event concludes, unused dice will be recycled and converted into "Lucky Coins".
 
2. "Sunflower Girl" Sign-in for Great Rewards!
※Event Info: Sign in during the event period to claim "Energy Dice" and other rewards!
 
3. "Daily Selection" Event Now Available!
※ Event Info: During the "Sunflower Girl" event period, the "Diamonds" rewards in the "Daily Selection" store packs will be replaced with "Dice" rewards, so masters who need them, please pick them up!
 
4. Suzumi's Express Project
※Event info: Suzumi has come to greet Masters with her assignments and generous rewards! Complete Suzumi's assigned tasks to earn the "Dice" prepared by Suzumi as a reward. You can use the "Dice" to participate in the "Sunflower Girl" event!

Ⅱ. "Rebekah's Secret Workshop" Open for a Limited Time!
※Event Schedule: Aug. 16, 06:00 - Aug. 22, 23:59
※Unlock Condition: Clear main story "2-24"
※Event details: During the event period, Masters can craft and modify your parts at "Rebekah's Secret Workshop". You can choose to craft parts, sets and main property. If you are not satisfied with the options, you can use "FULI Wishes" to refresh options. Masters can also modify parts that are qualified to change the property!

Ⅲ.Special Edition "Lafayette · Beach Wedding Ver." Limited-Time Return
※Event Schedule: Aug. 9, 06:00 - Aug. 22, 23:59
※Event Portal: Store → Commemorative Wheel  
※Event Info: During the reissue period, you can obtain "FULI Gilded Stele" through "Time Commemorative Wheel". "FULI Gilded Stele" can be used to redeem Special Edition "Lafayette · Beach Wedding Ver."

Ⅳ.  All-New "Combination Limited Rate Up" Now Available
※Event Schedule: Aug. 16, 06:00 - Sep. 6, 23:59
※Event Info:
1. When obtaining an Ultra figurine while using "FULI Wishes" during the event, there will be a higher chance for it to be the Rate Up Figurines. New Card Drawing: Ryoma Erikzia&Ayane Okada
2. The discounted packs, "Moe Items All-Rounder" and "Luxury Wishing Combo Gift" (limited to 1 purchase each) will be in stock during the event. These packs include the super value item, "FULI Wishes", so please don't miss out on them.

Ⅴ. Figurine Quiz Event "Lucky Quiz Star" Now Available!
※Event Schedule: Aug. 16, 06:00 - Aug. 22, 23:59
※Event Access: Lucky Quiz Star
※Event Info: Ta-dah! A mystery figurine is about to debut! There will be three rounds of quizzes about the new figurine during the event, where you can guess the Class, Brand and Prototype of the new figurine. If you guess correctly in the event, you will be rewarded with lots of "Commemorative Coins"!

notes.title: Game service update and maintenance on July 4th
notes.content:
To maintain a good gaming experience, the maintenance will start at 14:00 (UTC+8) on Jul. 4.
﻿
To ensure the quality of maintenance, the estimated time of this maintenance is 3 hours. Depending on the actual situation of maintenance, the server opening time of each region may be earlier or later, please pay attention to the announcement of our official Facebook page.
﻿
During the maintenance period, masters will not be able to enter the server to play. After the maintenance is over, we will send maintenance compensation to all masters by email (Diamond*200 for every 1 hour of maintenance). Please pay attention to the time during the maintenance period to avoid unnecessary losses.
﻿
[Maintenance Time] Jul. 4, 2024, 14:00~17:00 (UTC+8), expected to last 3 hours
﻿
[Maintenance Scope] All servers

notes.title: Change game language
notes.content:
The steps to change the game language are as follows:

1. After entering the game, click the gear in the upper right corner
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049746/5a0bac0cc985c9d70aae2f2a89559254d43d609d.png[/img]

2. Scroll to the bottom and select the language you want to change
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049746/4c5ac4f60b759ce389ae30caeaf1d7b0c62ebc67.jpg[/img]

3. Exit the game and re-enter
